en.title: Similar Password
en.description:
Change a lowercase password one character at a time by incrementing or decrementing a character by one, so that the number of vowels equals the number of consonants; the vowels are a, e, i, o, u.

All extra constraints and the I/O format are additions by this site and do not claim to be the original platform's format.
en.input: One line containing a string of lowercase English letters. The original problem has no complete constraints, and an odd length can never reach equality; this site only accepts even lengths 2..100000.
en.output: Output the minimum number of single-character increment/decrement operations.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First pin down the boundaries according to the statement, then handle the validity or optimality conditions that are easiest to miss.
